accessibility.contrast_strategy: Ensure text over images has sufficient shadow or gradient overlay. Floating actions must have aria-labels.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cinematic Apple-style landing page with a dark luxury theme (#0A0B0A).
Use Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll-triggered reveal animations.
Implement a sticky 'crystal glass' header that blurs the background.
The hero section should have the bottle floating (animate-float) over a dark moody mustard field.
Provide a floating action group on the bottom right (WhatsApp, Instagram, Call) using Phosphor Icons.
Build standard multi-step checkout and auth pages matching the luxury brand vibe (no standard generic borders, use subtle bottom borders for inputs).
Build an Admin Dashboard utilizing a dense grid with subtle 1px white/5 borders and no heavy drop shadows.
Ensure 'Poppins' font is loaded. Use wide-tracking uppercase for overlines, and large light-weight for H1s.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the provided media URLs exclusively.
